description: Health insurance medical-history intake, collected over an outbound voice call.

items.label: identity_confirm
items.prompt: Hello, this is the medical information line calling on behalf of {{insurerName}}. Am I speaking with {{customerName}}?
items.reprompt: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Am I speaking with {{customerName}}? You can just say yes or no.

items.label: recording_consent
items.prompt: Thank you. This call is recorded and the information is used only to process your policy application. It should take about five minutes. Do I have your consent to continue?
items.reprompt: I just need your consent to record and continue. Is that okay?

items.label: height_cm
items.prompt: Let's start with a couple of basics. What is your height?
items.reprompt: Could you tell me your height, in feet and inches or in centimetres?

items.label: weight_kg
items.prompt: And your current weight?
items.reprompt: What is your approximate weight, in kilograms or pounds?

items.label: tobacco_use
items.prompt: Do you currently use tobacco in any form, have you used it in the past, or never?
items.reprompt: Would you say never, formerly, or currently for tobacco use?

items.label: tobacco_quantity
items.prompt: Roughly how much, and for how many years?

items.label: alcohol_use
items.prompt: How often do you drink alcohol? Never, occasionally, weekly, or daily?

items.label: has_chronic_condition
items.prompt: Have you ever been diagnosed with any ongoing medical condition, such as diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, heart disease, or a thyroid condition?
items.reprompt: Have you been diagnosed with any long-term medical condition? Yes or no is fine.

items.label: chronic_condition_list
items.prompt: Could you tell me which conditions?
items.reprompt: Which conditions have you been diagnosed with?

items.label: condition_diagnosed_year
items.prompt: Around what year were you first diagnosed?

items.label: condition_controlled
items.prompt: Is the condition currently well controlled with treatment?

items.label: takes_medication
items.prompt: Are you currently taking any prescription medication?

items.label: medication_list
items.prompt: Which medications are you taking, and roughly what dosage?
items.reprompt: Could you name the medications you're currently on?

items.label: hospitalized_last_5_years
items.prompt: Have you been admitted to a hospital in the last five years, for any reason?
items.reprompt: In the past five years, have you spent a night or more in hospital?

items.label: hospitalization_reason
items.prompt: What were you admitted for?

items.label: hospitalization_when
items.prompt: When was that, approximately?

items.label: hospitalization_nights
items.prompt: How many nights did you stay?

items.label: had_surgery
items.prompt: Have you had any surgery or operation, at any point in your life?

items.label: surgery_details
items.prompt: What surgery was it, and roughly when?

items.label: family_history
items.prompt: Has any immediate family member, a parent or sibling, been diagnosed with heart disease, cancer, diabetes, or a stroke before the age of sixty?
items.reprompt: Any heart disease, cancer, diabetes or stroke in your parents or siblings before age sixty?

items.label: family_history_detail
items.prompt: Which condition, and which relative?

items.label: current_symptoms
items.prompt: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms that you haven't yet seen a doctor about?

items.label: current_symptoms_detail
items.prompt: Could you describe them for me?

items.label: pending_investigations
items.prompt: Are you waiting on the results of any medical test, scan, or biopsy?

items.label: email_confirm
items.prompt: Almost done. I have your email as {{customerEmail}}. Should I send the confirmation summary there?
items.reprompt: Which email address should I send your confirmation to?
